background.value: White, uniform, without stripes, spots, images of foreign objects or shadows ("белым, ровным, без полос, пятен и изображения посторонних предметов и теней")

head_height.value: Face must occupy 70–80% of the photo area ("размер лица должен составлять 70–80% площади фотографии"); for a 45mm-tall photo this computes to roughly 31.5–36mm, consistent with the DB's 3.2–3.6cm figure though not stated in cm directly by this source.

clothing_restriction.value: Military or official uniforms ("форменная одежда") are prohibited in the photo.

expression_restriction.value: Strictly frontal, looking straight ahead with a neutral expression, eyes open, mouth closed ("строго в анфас и смотрящим прямо с нейтральным выражением, глаза должны быть открыты, рот закрыт"); hair must not obscure the eyes.

glasses_policy.value: Glasses with tinted lenses are prohibited.

headwear_policy.value: Headwear is generally not allowed; a religious head covering that does not conceal the oval of the face ("не скрывающем овал лица") is permitted for those whose beliefs require appearing before others covered.

expression.en: Strictly frontal view, looking straight ahead with a neutral expression, eyes open, mouth closed; hair must not cover the eyes.
expression.ko: 정면을 똑바로 응시하며 무표정을 유지할 것. 눈은 뜨고 입은 다물어야 하며, 머리카락이 눈을 가리면 안 된다.
expression.ja: 正面を直視し、無表情を保つこと。目を開け口を閉じ、髪の毛が目にかからないこと。

glasses.en: Glasses with tinted lenses are prohibited.
glasses.ja: 色付きレンズの眼鏡は禁止。

headwear.en: Headwear is generally not allowed; a religious head covering that does not conceal the oval of the face is permitted.
headwear.ko: 모자 등 머리가리개는 원칙적으로 금지되나, 얼굴 윤곽을 가리지 않는 종교적 머리가리개는 허용된다.
headwear.ja: 帽子などの被り物は原則禁止だが、顔の輪郭を隠さない宗教上の頭部covering(スカーフ等)は許可される。

clothing.en: Military or official uniforms are prohibited in the photo.
clothing.ja: 軍服や制服の着用は不可。

db_conflicts.research_value: No absolute cm/mm figure is published by the source — specified only as a proportion (face = 70–80% of the photo area), which computes to approximately 31.5–36mm (3.15–3.6cm) for a 45mm-tall photo.

cross_verification.note_en: Source is the Consular Department of the Russian MFA (kdmid.ru), which administers passport services for Russian citizens; the stated rules match the well-known MVD Administrative Regulation (Order No. 851/186) figures publicly reported elsewhere. Size (35×45mm) and background (white) both match DB exactly — no conflict. DB's head_height (3.2–3.6cm) is not stated in cm directly by this source but is consistent with its 70–80%-face-occupancy rule applied to a 45mm-tall photo (≈31.5–36mm).
